nodes.notes: Only the failure path sets success:false explicitly (in Handle Insert Result) -- a genuine DB row from Insert Appointment has no 'success' field at all, so this checks 'not explicitly false' rather than 'is true', to correctly route the normal/successful case through to Format Results.

nodes.name: Delete Orphaned Calendar Event
nodes.notes: Compensating action for KNOWN_ISSUES.md's orphaned-calendar-event bug. Runs only when Insert Appointment failed (collision or otherwise) after the Google Calendar event had already been created. continueOnFail:true -- if this delete itself fails (e.g. event already gone, API hiccup), we still must return the original graceful booking-failure message to the agent, not a raw error about the cleanup attempt.

parameters.query:
-- Also finds the listing being viewed (by id or reference, from
-- book_appointment's listing_id) and the agent who owns the client's lead,
-- so the calendar event shows the address and goes in the agent's calendar.
-- 0033: plus what the client's confirmation email needs (agency name, the
-- listing's own page, price and size) and the conversation's channel.
select ac.google_calendar_id, t.timezone, t.name as tenant_name, t.assistant_mode,
       -- 0042: whose calendar could take it (lead owner first), and the travel buffer.
       ac.booking_buffer_minutes,
       (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)), '[]'::jsonb)
          from booking_candidates($1, $2, $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz) b) as candidates,
       -- 0034: the email the client just gave for the confirmation wins over the one on file.
       c.name as contact_name,
       coalesce(case when nullif(btrim($5), '') ~ '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$' then lower(btrim($5)) end, c.email) as contact_email,
       c.phone as contact_phone,
       li.id as listing_id, li.title as listing_title, li.reference as listing_reference,
       nullif(concat_ws(', ', li.address, li.district, li.city), '') as listing_address,
       li.url as listing_url, li.price as listing_price, li.currency as listing_currency,
       li.transaction_type as listing_transaction_type, li.area_m2 as listing_area_m2, li.rooms as listing_rooms,
       ag.email as agent_email, coalesce(ag.full_name, ag.email) as agent_name,
       cv.id as conversation_id, cv.channel as conversation_channel
from ai_config ac
join tenants t on t.id = ac.tenant_id
left join contacts c on c.id = $2 and c.tenant_id = $1
left join conversations cv on cv.id::text = nullif($4, '') and cv.tenant_id = $1
left join lateral (
    select l.id, l.title, l.reference, l.address, l.district, l.city, l.url, l.price, l.currency,
           l.transaction_type, l.area_m2, l.rooms
    from listings l
    where l.tenant_id = $1 and nullif($3, '') is not null
      and (l.id::text = $3 or lower(l.reference) = lower($3))
    order by (l.id::text = $3) desc
    limit 1
) li on true
left join lateral (
    select u.email, u.full_name
    from leads ld
    join tenant_users u on u.id = ld.assigned_to and u.removed_at is null
    where ld.tenant_id = $1 and ld.contact_id = $2
    order by ld.updated_at desc
    limit 1
) ag on true
where ac.tenant_id = $1;

parameters.query:
-- agent_id is filled in by trg_appointments_fill_links (0030) from the
-- lead's owner; listing_id comes from 'Load Tenant + Contact Info';
-- conversation_id (0033) is the chat the viewing was booked in.
-- 0034: an email the client gave for the confirmation is saved on their
-- contact too, unless another contact in the agency already has it.
with saved_email as (
    update contacts set email = $10
    where id = $2 and tenant_id = $1 and nullif($10, '') is not null
      and email is distinct from $10
      and not exists (select 1 from contacts o where o.tenant_id = $1 and lower(o.email) = $10 and o.id <> $2)
    returning id
)
-- 0042: the agent whose calendar it went in, and that calendar (no double
-- booking per calendar).
insert into appointments (tenant_id, contact_id, starts_at, ends_at, timezone, status, external_calendar_id, notes, listing_id, conversation_id, agent_id, booked_calendar_id)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'confirmed', $6, $7, nullif($8, '')::uuid, nullif($9, '')::uuid, nullif($11, '')::uuid, $12)
returning id, starts_at, ends_at, status, listing_id, conversation_id;
